_sources.trabeculae: LV: trabeculated on the mid and apical anterior, lateral and inferolateral walls, the septum (mid septal 4%) and base smooth (Kawel 2012; Dawson 2011: trabeculated layer 4.2-7.1 mm in those segments, median 0 septal and basal); about 54 trabeculae per heart, strips about 2 mm wide (Halaney 2017, Fatemifar 2019; hypertrophied hearts). RV sizes still a GUESS (not found)
_sources.pectinate: LAA: 11 +- 4 muscles 0.9-1.2 mm thick (Lexova 2026, Slodowska 2021); RAA: 17 +- 4 (Lexova 2026); RA muscle thickness GUESS (not found)
_sources.fossa: Klimek-Piotrowska 2016: 14.1 x 12.1 mm; limbus thickness GUESS (not found)
